# Ref lock stripes (SPEC-REFS 5.1.1): <full ref name> <stripe> <lock file>.
# The stripe is the first byte of the BLAKE3 digest of the name's bytes, as
# two lowercase hex digits. The lock file is refs-<stripe>.lock under
# <root>/.kit/refs/. Checked by scripts/golden/ref_locks_ref.py.
# The spec's example.
refs/heads/main ec refs-ec.lock
# The packmap of a branch.
refs/kit/packmap/main 7b refs-7b.lock
# A tag.
refs/tags/v1.0.0 e2 refs-e2.lock
# A ref and a ref below it.
refs/heads/a 1b refs-1b.lock
refs/heads/a/b 02 refs-02.lock
# Edge characters of the grammar.
refs/heads/0 0e refs-0e.lock
refs/heads/A.b_c-D 0a refs-0a.lock
refs/heads/MiXeD-Case 2c refs-2c.lock
refs/heads/release/2024_09 5b refs-5b.lock
refs/heads/x- 6e refs-6e.lock
refs/heads/v1.0.0-rc.1_build 8e refs-8e.lock
# 32 segments, the most a name may have.
refs/heads/s1/s2/s3/s4/s5/s6/s7/s8/s9/s10/s11/s12/s13/s14/s15/s16/s17/s18/s19/s20/s21/s22/s23/s24/s25/s26/s27/s28/s29/s30 06 refs-06.lock
# 512 bytes, the longest name.
 26 refs-26.lock
 81 refs-81.lock
